job.job_description:
Key Skills:

GenAI applications using Gemini/Open-Source LLMs (Code Translation, Summarization, Text Extraction, SDLC Optimization)
AI Agents, Chatbots, RAG, LangChain, LangGraph, LangSmith
Vector Databases (PGVector, ChromaDB)
LLM Evaluation (RAGAS, DeepEval, Pegasus)
Python (mandatory), TypeScript & ReactJS (preferred)
Prompt Engineering, Guardrails, Hallucination & PII Mitigation
API Development, Microservices, API Gateway, Istio
AI Security, DDoS/Denial-of-Wallet Prevention
MLOps, ML Model Development & Deployment
GCP Cloud and End-to-End Data Integration

Responsibilities: Develop and deploy GenAI/ML solutions, build AI agents and RAG systems, create scalable ML pipelines, evaluate model performance, implement AI governance and security controls, and collaborate with cross-functional teams to deliver business-focused AI solutions.
